content: Keefɛ bɛŋ dûunyi yeye yeye gɛ
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, no bɛŋ le bɛŋ leesɛ wa muntele yi Tada wese besabɛŋ wù Jiso Kletu wù le Tada wu bvukugɛ, keefɛ bɛŋ dûunyi yeye yeye gɛ.
Njɛme noo nje taŋlo bamii bafɛɛ ja bo to fɛ kintaashɛ kena le, muh mu jii njú yì joŋe, wu lee muncha mu ba kɛnyɛ bɛ kichwa ki bige kì yɛɛde, wumu nyu fie muh kifufe, wu jii njú yì saayɛ.
Bɛŋ mo bɛŋ jɛmɛ muh wu kifufe le lɛ, “Lɛ̂ɛŋ fɛge!”, kɛnɛ lɛ, “Tô shîlɛ fɛkuu fɛnɛ yi nshɛŋ le”, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ nya bvufee nyu yi muh wu suse ye wɛɛ le, bɛŋ jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Gɛ̀ tô shîlɛ fɛnɛ!”
Nɛ bɛŋ ja bɛŋ ge noo, tu gɛ bɛŋ tu wa bamii ba suune bansa ba muntele mù yiide gɛ? Gɛ finɛ fiɛɛ yɛnɛ lɛ bɛŋ duunyi yeye yeye a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ gɛ?

Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ ba le shɛ́ŋ yaŋ, bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, gɛ nyu bamii ba kifufe ba fɛkuu fɛnɛ ba Nyo le wu cha lɛ bo kɛ̂me mbɛmɛ wu le wu yisɛ gɛ? Gɛ ka nyume bo ba Nyo lé wu gê wu nyâ bo kijusɛ antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bwe bvù wu gɛ̀ ka muh wuchii wu koŋe wu le gɛ?
Geenɛ, bɛŋ jade fiena bɛŋ tu choose lo muh kifufe a yinɛ je le, bɛŋ yɛne gɛh nyu muh kwa le. Bamii ba nyuse bɛŋ bo chiide bɛŋ bo gɛɛne bɛ bɛŋ yéh yi bansa le, le baaŋ? Gɛ nyume bamii ba kwa gɛ?
Gɛ ka nyume gɛh bo ba jɛme jɛ́ yì befe kune jee chi ŋgvunɛ chiɛɛ chì ba chu ye yene le gɛ?
Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛde nchi wu Nfoŋ wù Nyo wù le a Ŋwa we le. Nchi wunɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo kôŋe muh wù le mbebe yo le no wo koŋe kikwɛɛ kuŋ.”

content: Nɛ bɛŋ gee noo, tu bɛŋ gee chuule.
Geenɛ, bɛŋ nɛ duunyi yeye yeye, tu le kimbefɛ bɛŋ gee, tu bɛŋ le bɛŋ ŋgodɛ nchi wu koo bɛŋ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ nɛ muh gɛɛde mo nyu banchi ba Nyo bachii, wu ge wu ŋgodɛ wu mumwaa, tu wu le wu ŋgodɛ wa bachii.
Fi le noo, nje Nyo wù gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ wo jâŋ kwɛ muh kɛnɛ juma muh gîiŋ bɛ muh mu gɛ”

content: le gɛh tɛ wu wù gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,
Nɛ wo le njɛ wo jo kwɛ muh kɛnɛ juma muh sɛŋ, geenɛ wo yuuyɛ muh, tu wo le wo ŋgodɛ nchi wu Nyo.
Noo, bɛŋ jɛ̂me bɛŋ ka gêe mwɛɛ njɛ bamii ba Nyo lé wu gê wu sâge bo wu bii nchi wù bvuuse bamii bvunfa le.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ sege Nyo doo wu sage nsa, wu gɛ ka wu koo yii fɛ muh wù gɛ̀ baaŋ koo gɛ yii fɛ muh mu le gɛ. Geenɛ, muh wù koode yii lé wu gê wu bônɛ yi nsa le.
Fiɛɛ fì duunyi lɛ muh le wu leesɛ fitele yi Nyo le, le gee che chì chuule
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, muh nɛ jade wu mo wu duu lɛ wu le wu leesɛ wa fitele yi Nyo le, gɛ njɛ gee che duunyi noo sɛŋ, fifiɛɛ lé fi gê fi fîh wu yi la le? Taŋlo fitele fì wu leese fiyu ge fi bvûsɛ wu?
Ba jo lɛ, mwa bwoo wù jwɛŋsɛ kɛnɛ wù kwɛse ja wu tu wu fuge njú bɛ mwɛɛ munjile mu aju achii,

wu to fɛ wo le, wo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Nyo nôŋ kimbonɛ yi wo le, wo kɛ̂mɛ njú bɛ mwɛɛ munjile.” Nɛ wo jɛme gɛh lo noo, njɛ wo nya wu bɛ mwɛɛ mù wu goone yi kinche ke le sɛŋ, fifiɛɛ lé fi fîh wu yi la le?
Bɛŋ baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ lɛ, muh duu lɛ wu le wu leesɛ fitele yi Nyo le, njɛ gee che duunyi noo sɛŋ, tu fitele fì wu leese lɛfilɛfi le fi kwe wa gɛ?

Muh mu taŋlo wu ja wu du lɛ, fi muh mu le lɛ wu le wu lee nyu fitele yi Nyo le, fi muh mu nyu lɛ wu gee nyu gee chì kooji. Mɛ mo njɛme lɛ wu dunyɛ no taŋlo muh leesɛ fitele yi Nyo le, njɛ gee che kooji lo sɛŋ, ndunyɛ wu no nle nleesɛ fitele yi Nyo le nyu yi gee chaŋ chì kooji le.
Nɛ muh bɛmɛ lɛ Nyo le wu mumwaa, tu le chuule. Geenɛ, mo banchɛndaa ba debele tɛ le bo bɛɛŋ gɛh noo bo tu bo faane, bo koge.
Wɛɛ muh le kiyuŋ. Wu goone lɛ ndunyɛ lɛ nɛ muh leese fitele yi Nyo le njɛ gee che joŋe lo sɛŋ, tu le achiji?

Gɛ fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ ge Nyo yɛŋ lɛ Ablaham wù chiji wese besabɛŋ le wu kojɛ muh we le, gɛ̀ bee gee che chì kooji gɛ? Gɛ wu gɛ̀ jo mwa ye wù Asik, wu giiŋsɛ yi kitana ki kintanyɛ le ki wu gê kintanyɛ yu fɛ Nyo le gɛ?
Bɛŋ yɛŋ gɛ lɛ fitele fì wu gɛ̀ leesɛ yi Nyo le, bɛ gee che chì kooji gɛ̀ jiɛnyi kikaa kimimia gɛ? Gee che chì kooji gɛ̀ bee chi dunyɛ lɛ fitele fì wu gɛ̀ leesɛ yi Nyo le gɛ̀ yisɛ.
Fi mo fi kojɛ no ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ablaham gɛ̀ bee wu leesɛ fitele yi Nyo le,
nje noo, Nyo yɛŋ lɛ wu le muh wù chaaŋ.”

content: Ba mo ba tɛŋe wu lɛ nsaa yi Nyo.
Bɛŋ baaŋ ka yɛŋ gɛ lɛ fiɛɛ fì to fi ge Nyo yɛŋ lɛ muh le wu kojɛ muh we le nyu gee chì kooji, gɛ mɛ gɛh fitele fì wu leese yi Nyo le maa gɛ?

Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fi Lahab wù gɛ̀ bee kwɛse wu kinjikuu gɛ̀ bee. Fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ ge Nyo yɛŋ lɛ wu le wu kojɛ muh we le, gɛ̀ bee gee che chì kooji. Wu gɛ̀ bee wu fi baŋkeeyɛ ba Ishwala a wu ye, ajiŋ ayu wu dunyɛ bo je yimi yi yeye yì bo wɛ̂ɛŋ bo tû jiŋ yi le.
Fi tu fi nyume lɛ, gɛ no kiyo chinɛ nyaŋ yi ye le, yi tu nyu wa kiŋkwe ki fiɛɛ lɛ, le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no muh leese fitele yi Nyo le, njɛ gee che kooji lo sɛŋ tu fitele fiyu le kiŋkwe ki fiɛɛ lɛ.
